headline: Certified Accountant (OCC) | Corporate Accounting & Tax Compliance
summary: Certified Accountant registered with the Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC) with 4.5 years of in-house accounting and tax compliance experience in the manufacturing and wholesale sectors. Solid command of Portuguese accounting standards (SNC), periodic tax filings, and financial closing procedures using PHC software.

experience.title: Certified Accountant
bullets: Execute full-cycle general accounting in compliance with the Sistema de Normalização Contabilística (SNC) for an industrial company with €8M in annual turnover.
Prepare and submit monthly and annual tax declarations, including VAT (IVA), Corporate Income Tax (IRC - Modelo 22), IES, and withholding taxes.
Manage monthly bank reconciliations, fixed assets ledger, and accruals using PHC Enterprise.
Streamlined the monthly closing checklist, reducing reporting delivery time from 12 to 9 working days.

experience.title: General Accountant
bullets: Processed and classified daily accounting documents, including supplier invoices, expense reports, and treasury movements in PHC.
Assisted in the preparation of periodic VAT returns, DMR, and Social Security declarations.
Maintained control over accounts payable and accounts receivable, reconciling over 150 supplier accounts quarterly.
Supported external auditors during annual statutory audits by preparing requested trial balances and supporting schedules.

certifications: Active member of the Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC - Portuguese Chartered Accountants Association)
